title: SugarCraft — SugarReleases
description: SugarReleases: phar self-update engine and launch-time update notice — GitHub release selection (stable + rolling dev channel), sha256 sidecar and pinned-key Ed25519 verification before the swap, one-shot rollback, Windows relaunch-dance swap. Extracted from candy-code; first-party.
ogDescription: One fail-closed self-update engine for every phar-shipped SugarCraft app: pick the right release from a shared GitHub release stream, verify the bytes before the rename, keep a one-shot undo copy, and tell the user at launch when a newer release exists.
tagline: Phar self-update engine — verify before the swap, one-shot rollback
